used_fields: ae.dat: span, chord, relative thickness; htc blade1 c2_def: span, twist (sign mapped), Y centreline for normalized static prebend shape
not_used: No DTU controller, binary library, structural dynamics, aerodynamic coefficient tables, mass, rated power or elastic response used
section_limitation: Pinned FFA-W3-241/301/360 coordinate contours from WISDEM IEA-15 reference supply section camber. Only normalized contours are imported; no 15 MW dimensions or dynamics. Scaled thick sections, circular root blending, trailing-edge seam and tip closure are adaptations, not exact GW184 or DTU blade surfaces.

airfoil_reference.scope: Only FFA-W3-241/301/360 geometric contours; no IEA-15MW dimensions or polars imported; adapted reference not exact DTU/GW184 surface

prebend: HTC blade1 C2-def Y, normalized after root offset removal; chosen target amplitude 3.0 m upwind at zero pitch. Static rigid shape rotates with collective pitch; not measured GW184 or aerodynamic deflection.
